rules.statement: Equity does not allow the Statute of Frauds to be used as an instrument for fraud, and this principle cannot be applied to a case where the absence of the writing is due merely to non-performance of an informal contract to execute one.
rules.supporting_quote: "This principle cannot be applied to such a case as this. It does operate in certain classes of cases. 'It is a fraud on the part of a person to whom land is conveyed as a trustee and who knows it is so conveyed, to deny the trust and claim the land himself.'"
